metas.name: Dexter: Resurrection
metas.description: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

metas.name: Dept. Q
metas.description: A brash but brilliant cop becomes head of a new police department, where he leads an unlikely team of misfits in solving Edinburgh's cold cases.

metas.name: Widow's Bay
metas.description: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.

metas.name: Dexter: Original Sin
metas.description: In 1991 Miami, Dexter Morgan transitions from student to avenging serial killer. When his bloodthirsty urges can't be ignored any longer, Dexter must learn to channel his inner darkness. With the guidance of his father, Harry, he adopts a Code designed to help him find and kill people who deserve to be eliminated from society without getting on law enforcements' radar. This is a particular challenge for young Dexter as he begins a forensics internship at the Miami Metro Police Department.

metas.name: A Shop for Killers
metas.description: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

metas.name: Boy Swallows Universe
metas.description: A young boy growing up in the suburbs of 1980s Brisbane faces the harsh realities of life — and the looming dangers that threaten his family.

metas.name: Light Shop
metas.description: In a mysterious shop that sells lamps, the dead may return to the world of the living, while the living may not walk out alive.

metas.name: Presumed Innocent
metas.description: A horrific murder upends the Chicago Prosecuting Attorney's Office when one of its own is suspected of the crime—leaving the accused fighting to keep his family together.

metas.name: Detective Hole
metas.description: When a series of ritualistic murders hits Oslo, a gifted detective must navigate a puzzle of patterns, corruption and his own demons to catch the killer.

metas.name: Friendly Rivalry
metas.description: A high-teen mystery thriller about a close relationship between teenage girls in a harsher survival competition than entrance examinations.

metas.name: The Price of Confession
metas.description: Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.

metas.name: All Her Fault
metas.description: In Chicago, Marissa Irvine arrives at 14 Arthur Avenue, expecting to pick up her young son Milo from his first playdate with a boy at his new school. But the woman who answers the door isn't a mother she recognizes. She isn't the nanny. She doesn't have Milo. And so begins every parent's worst nightmare.

metas.name: Disclaimer
metas.description: When an intriguing novel appears at the bedside of a journalist whose career has been built on revealing transgressions, she is horrified to realize she's a key character in a long-buried story—one that exposes her darkest secret.

metas.name: The Beast in Me
metas.description: A famous author is pulled into a twisted mind game with her rich, powerful new neighbor — who might be a murderer.

metas.name: Sterling Point
metas.description: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

metas.name: DTF St. Louis
metas.description: A love triangle among three adults experiencing middle-age malaise leads to one of them ending up dead.

metas.name: The Art of Sarah
metas.description: A body found in the middle of town. A luxe label on the rise. A detective tests every stitch of a woman's story that keeps changing. What really happened?

metas.name: Black Doves
metas.description: When a spy posing as a politician's wife learns her lover has been murdered, an old assassin friend joins her on a quest for truth — and vengeance.

metas.name: The 8 Show
metas.description: Eight individuals trapped in a mysterious 8-story building participate in a tempting but dangerous show where they earn money as time passes.

metas.name: HIS & HERS
metas.description: Two estranged spouses — one a detective, the other a news reporter — vie to solve a murder in which each believes the other is a prime suspect.

metas.name: UNTAMED
metas.description: In the vast expanse of Yosemite National Park, a woman's death draws a federal agent into lawless terrain — where nature obeys no rules but its own.

metas.name: I Will Find You
metas.description: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

metas.name: Red Eye
metas.description: London police officer DC Hana Li is escorting Dr Matthew Nolan back to Beijing where he has been accused of a crime. However, on board flight 357, she finds herself embroiled in an escalating conspiracy and a growing number of murders.

metas.name: The Last Night at Tremore Beach
metas.description: When a tormented pianist is struck by lightning, he begins having perilous visions of his future and a deadly threat seems to loom over his loved ones.

metas.name: A Murder at the End of the World
metas.description: Gen Z amateur sleuth and tech-savvy hacker Darby Hart and eight other guests are invited by a reclusive billionaire to participate in a retreat at a remote location. When one of the other guests is found dead, Darby must use her skills to prove it was murder before the killer takes another life.

metas.name: The Better Sister
metas.description: Chloe moves in New York's most elite circles with her lawyer husband Adam and teenage son Ethan by her side while her estranged sister Nicky tries to make ends meet and stay clean. When Adam is brutally murdered, the investigation sends shockwaves through the family and exposes long-buried secrets.

metas.name: Down Cemetery Road
metas.description: When a child goes missing in the aftermath of a house explosion, a concerned neighbor teams up with a private investigator to find them. As secrets unravel and a military conspiracy emerges, all hell is unleashed on South Oxford's sleepy suburbs.

metas.name: If Wishes Could Kill
metas.description: A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.

metas.name: The Edge of Sleep
metas.description: When a night watchman finishes his shift at work, he is terrified to discover that everyone in the world who went to sleep the previous night has died. Now he and a band of survivors must stay awake and uncover the secret of this global epidemic, before they fall asleep.

metas.name: Last Seen
metas.description: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

metas.name: The Trunk
metas.description: A secret marriage service is uncovered when a trunk washes up on the shore, revealing the strange marriage between a couple in the thick of it all.

metas.name: Sherlock & Daughter
metas.description: Sherlock Holmes faces a sinister case risking friends' lives. American Amelia joins, seeking her father after her mother's murder. Despite differences, they solve a conspiracy and her mother's case.
